_source: Aircraft type names from tar1090-db (https://github.com/wiedehopf/tar1090-db, db/icao_aircraft_types2.js), built from the Mictronics aircraft database (https://www.mictronics.de/aircraft-database/). Format: ICAO type designator -> [name, class]. Class is the first letter of the ICAO description: L landplane, S seaplane, A amphibian, H helicopter, G gyrocopter, T tiltrotor.
